Stock market news | SEBI proposes scrapping FPI disclosure rules

SEBI announced a proposal to scrap the additional disclosure framework that foreign portfolio investors currently follow. The change would eliminate extra reporting obligations for these investors.
The proposal seeks to stem capital outflows and attract more foreign money into Indian equities, potentially easing market liquidity and supporting investment growth.
